cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.30)

# GPU-shader controls (gmpi_ui shader brushes, GmpiApiShaders.h). GUI-only.
# The .sh files are the shaders; shaders/compiled/*.cpp are their blob tables,
# regenerated by gmpi_ui's compile_shaders.cmake (command in each .sh) and
# committed, so building this bundle needs no shaderc.
project(GpuFx)

gmpi_plugin(
	PROJECT_NAME ${PROJECT_NAME}
	HAS_GUI
	IS_OFFICIAL_MODULE
	SOURCE_FILES
	  FluidGui.cpp
	  fluid.sh
	  shaders/compiled/shaders_fluid.cpp
	  ${GMPI_UI_SDK}/helpers/Timer.cpp
)

set_source_files_properties(fluid.sh PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE)

# helpers/Timer.cpp's mac path is CFRunLoopTimer (see TiDEPanel's note).
if(APPLE)
    target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE "-framework CoreFoundation")
endif()
